label: HINGE_1: A HINGE_1 is a true proposition that is known, as Moore claimed to know that here is a hand
definition: A hinge is a true proposition that is known, as Moore claimed to know that here is a hand. The reading the floor's observation basis would presuppose for F3 and F4 if they were hinges.
note: Contrast sense: Über Gewißheit §151 denies that Moore knows his propositions; the sense is kept so that DISAMB-HINGE-STATUS names the reading under which hinges would be established floor items.
